verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies this capability through SvelteKit, the official meta-framework that the docs compare to Next/Nuxt (svelte-docs-18). One community comment praises how clearly SvelteKit separates what is loaded on the server versus the client (svelte-comm-1), which suggests server-side data loading feeds rendered pages. Nothing documents async server-rendered components or passing server-fetched data into interactive client components. missing for 10: first-party docs on server data loading (e.g. load functions) or async components, an explicit server-to-client data-passing/hydration mechanism, hands-on corroboration.
